progress.scope: Retrospective net VIPE-estimated displacement along the desired boundary-to-end direction. No independent physical-motion claim; invalid gauges omitted. Native horizons differ and no limit-cycle test is implied.

observer_prefix.scope: Full-video VIPE estimates of exact shared RGB prefixes. Nonzero disagreement may reflect estimator variation, continuation-dependent SLAM geometry, and independent depth registration. Descriptive diagnostic, not a calibrated noise bound or automatic significance test. Invalid position gauges omitted. Float32 rotations are projected to SO(3) before rotation comparison, preventing nonorthogonality from creating a false self-distance.

visual_review.scope: Retrospective inspection of six sampled frame IDs per completed pair against recording RGB. Not a full-video or independent physical ground-truth assessment. No raw metrics changed.

boundary_seams.scope: Three adjacent transitions around each native boundary, downsampled RGB in [0,1]. Pixel MAE and per-channel affine photometric fit are descriptive appearance measures, not optical flow, camera velocity, or a collapse threshold. No registration/warping is applied.
